questions.question: There are three types of lists in Indian Constitution, viz., the Union List, the State list and the _____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**option 3 i.e., Concurrent List.**__

__
 
• The Seventh Schedule of the Constitution of India is about the subject of the distribution of legislative powers between the Union and the States that are defined under several articles.
 
• Articles 245 and 246 of the Indian Constitution have been defined in the Seventh Schedule of Indian Constitution.
 
• The Seventh Schedule of the Indian constitution consists of three lists i.e. Union List, State List, and Concurrent List.__

 
• **Union List**: 100 items on which Parliament has exclusive power to make laws
 
• **State List**: It has 61 subjects. Earlier, it had 66 items.
 
• **Concurrent List**: 52 items on which both Central and State governments can make laws. The idea of the Concurrent List in the Indian constitution is adopted from the Australian Constitution.

questions.question: In Angiosperms, plant embryos in seed have structures called ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Cotyledon

**Cotyledon:**

 
• In Angiosperms, plant embryos in the seed have structures called cotyledons also known as seed leaves.
 
• Flowering plants whose embryos have a single cotyledon are called monocots, or monocotyledonous plants.
 
• Flowering plants whose embryos have two cotyledons are called dicots, or dicotyledonous plants

questions.question: Calculate the pressure (in Pa) if a thrust of 1000 N is applied to an area of 5 m².
questions.solution:
__**Concept:**__

Pressure: It is the component of the force normal to the area under consideration.

__
 
• Its dimensions are [ML–1T–2]
 
• The pressure is a scalar quantity since force is a vector quantity 
 
• The SI unit of pressure is Nm–2. It has been named pascal (Pa)

**FORMULA:**

We know,

**Pressure (P) = Force(F)/Area(A)**

**Calculation:**__

We have,

Force(F) = 1000 N

Area(A) = 5 m²

Therefore,

P = 1000/5 = 200 N/m² = 200 Pa

Hence, the pressure is __**200 Pa.**__

questions.question: 1 kWh = ________ × 10⁶ J.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** 3.6**__**.**

**__CALCULATION:__**

**Kilowatt-hours (kWh) and joules (J) **are units of energy.

1 kW = 1000 W

1 watt(W) = 1 J/sec

Therefore, 1 kW = 1000 J/sec

 And, 1 hour = 3600 sec

So, 1 kWh = (1000 J/sc) × 3600 sec

= __**3.6 × 106 J.**__
